in_hebrew.name: באובייס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words ‘באו’ (beau) meaning beautiful and ‘בית’ (vais) meaning house or dwelling.

in_greek.name: Βεαύαις
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek words ‘βεαο’ (beao) meaning beautiful and ‘οικη’ (vais) meaning house or dwelling.

in_latin.name: Beauvaisius
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin words ‘bellus’ (beau) meaning beautiful and ‘vadis’ (vais) meaning way or passage, referring to a beautiful dwelling or passage.
